name: A level-60 leader with open world scaling off does not stop the party's dungeon from scaling
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1 and DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1 with the default DestinyWeaver.Scaling.DungeonIds.
While grouped, the leader's Destiny Weaver switch is every member's open world scaling switch. A scaled
five-player dungeon does not consult it: Ascension scales classic dungeons to each character inside them, so a
level-60 leader with the switch off must not hold a level-26 member to Maraudon's authored level-45 creatures.
Maraudon (map 349) holds its band from LFGDungeons.dbc TargetLevelMin 20; the member, whose own switch is on but
who follows the leader's off switch while grouped, still sees a level-45 Black Riding Wolf 5194 at 26.

steps.label: Let the group's switch reach the member
DISCRIMINATING: the member sees the Maraudon creature at their own level
The member's client is sent level 26
